Shared motifs, rarest first: Wealth does not profit on the day of wrath (weight 5.4). Pair score 5.4.

Only in Zephaniah's Day of YHWH against Judah: Men thickened on their lees who say in their hearts 'YHWH will do neither good nor evil'; The Day of YHWH is a sacrifice he has prepared, with invited guests consecrated; Litany of the Day: day of wrath, distress, ruin, darkness, cloud and thick darkness, shofar and alarm; God will search Jerusalem with lamps to find the complacent; Named districts of Jerusalem (Fish Gate, Mishneh/Second Quarter, Maktesh/Mortar) wail; A prophet's genealogy is traced several generations back to a king (Hezekiah); God will punish officials and princes who wear foreign garments; People bow and swear both by YHWH and by Malkam (their king or Milcom); God will sweep away humans, beasts, birds of the air and fish of the sea from the face of the ground (creation reversed); Idolatrous priests (kemarim) who burned incense to Baal, sun, moon, constellations are put down; 'The imminent (al-azifa) has drawn near'; none but God can remove it; Priests do not tread on a temple threshold, explained by an event; and 7 more.

Only in The dawn: Iram of the pillars and the soul at peace: The people of 'Ad and Iram of the pillars ('imad), the like of which was never created in the lands; When God tests a man with bounty he says 'my Lord honored me'; when he restricts his provision he says 'my Lord humiliated me'; On the day man remembers, too late, and says 'Would that I had sent ahead (good deeds) for my life'; The soul at peace (al-nafs al-mutma'inna) is called to return to its Lord, well-pleased and pleasing, and enter his garden; Thamud cut out the rock in the valley (for dwellings); Hell (or the Lord) lies in wait (mirsad) as a watch-post for the transgressors; Pharaoh 'possessor of the stakes' (dhu al-awtad); The Spirit and the angels, or the angels with the coming Lord, stand rank upon rank (saffan saffa) on judgment day; Edom dwells in the clefts of the rock (sela) and thinks no one can bring it down; The sin of Sodom was pride, surfeit of bread and careless ease, not strengthening the hand of the poor and needy; On that day hell is brought forth, exposed or kindled for whoever sees, and paradise brought near; The deniers do not honor the orphan, push him away, and do not urge the feeding of the poor; and 4 more.
